items.question: What destroys terrible poison after drinking it and by anointing guñjābalāṃ nataḥ?
premises: Drinking terrible poison is destroyed by pītvā.
Anointing guñjābalāṃ nataḥ is also stated.
items.inference: The verse states that drinking destroys terrible poison, while anointing guñjābalāṃ nataḥ is mentioned alongside it.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of nataḥ and guñjābalāṃ remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Having drunk, it destroys terrible poison; by anointing guñjābalāṃ nataḥ.
